{"reason": "All 14 failure rows are demand-forecast-error mislabeled unknown: market-mismatch=#t events and bias events (0.065–0.081) just under the 0.1 cutoff. Adding market-signal-mismatch to the forecast branch and lowering the bias threshold to 0.05 routes these claims to demand-forecast-error, raising accuracy and recovered amount.", "source": "(define (claim-root-cause expedite-event)
  (cond
    ((and (edi-increase? expedite-event)
          (supplier-lead-time-miss? expedite-event))
     'supplier-delay)
    ((or (market-signal-mismatch? expedite-event)
         (and (forecast-bias? expedite-event)
              (> (bias-amount expedite-event) 0.05)))
     'demand-forecast-error)
    (else 'unknown)))"}
